title.narrative: Enhancing the Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Contribution to the Food Security in Egypt Project

description.narrative: The overall goal of the project is to contribute to strengthening the food security of Egypt by enhancing the productivity and sustainability of MSEs operating in the food and agriculture sector. A total of 1,100 MSEs operating in the food and agriculture sector, with 20% being women-owned and 20% being youth-owned enterprises, will have access to Shariah-compliant financing. Various agricultural production activities, along with their value chains including food processing, packing, and marketing will be supported. In addition, the trading of wholesale or retail of food products and agricultural inputs, including agricultural and irrigation equipment, will be part of the financing. Furthermore, nearly 600 stakeholders including MSEs owners and MSMEDA staff will be provided a training on Islamic Finance. At the end of the project, around one million people will have access to food security products in the targeted area. Furthermore, the MSEs will generate 2,900 new employment opportunities, with a special emphasis on rural areas, women and youth. Additionally, as a result of this project, the Islamic Finance window in MSMEDA operations will experience a significant increase from 1.6% to 3.5%.
